meta.source: Approved review of reference screenshots (light 02:47, dark 02:40); generated with Material Color Utilities 0.4.0, spec 2021, variant fidelity, contrastLevel 0. Typography, spacing, radius, shadow and sizes measured from the same screenshots at density 2.8125 (1080 px wide = 384 dp), rounded to the nearest dp step.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: FilledButton, active navigation icon and label (light), active page dot (light). Same value in both themes. As text on `surface`: light 6.43:1; dark 3.01:1, so dark text in `primary` only at 18sp+ or 14sp bold.

tokens.name: onPrimary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `primary` and `surfaceTint` (6.43:1 both themes).

tokens.name: primaryContainer
tokens.usage: FAB, soft emphasis. Equals `primary` here (fidelity keeps the seed), so do not place it next to a FilledButton.

tokens.name: onPrimaryContainer
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `primaryContainer`.

tokens.name: primaryFixed
tokens.usage: Decorative top-of-page glow in light (left stop). Same in both themes.

tokens.name: primaryFixedDim
tokens.usage: Darker step of `primaryFixed`.

tokens.name: onPrimaryFixed
tokens.usage: Text on `primaryFixed` and `primaryFixedDim`.

tokens.name: onPrimaryFixedVariant
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `primaryFixed`.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Low-emphasis accents.

tokens.name: onSecondary
tokens.usage: Text on `secondary`.

tokens.name: secondaryContainer
tokens.usage: Chip. NavigationBar has no indicator. Never a button background.

tokens.name: onSecondaryContainer
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `secondaryContainer`.

tokens.name: secondaryFixed
tokens.usage: Fixed secondary step, same in both themes.

tokens.name: secondaryFixedDim
tokens.usage: Darker step of `secondaryFixed`.

tokens.name: onSecondaryFixed
tokens.usage: Text on `secondaryFixed`.

tokens.name: onSecondaryFixedVariant
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `secondaryFixed`.

tokens.name: tertiary
tokens.usage: Third accent. Not used on the reviewed screens.

tokens.name: onTertiary
tokens.usage: Text on `tertiary`.

tokens.name: tertiaryContainer
tokens.usage: Promo and highlight cards.

tokens.name: onTertiaryContainer
tokens.usage: Text on `tertiaryContainer`.

tokens.name: tertiaryFixed
tokens.usage: Fixed tertiary step.

tokens.name: tertiaryFixedDim
tokens.usage: Darker step of `tertiaryFixed`.

tokens.name: onTertiaryFixed
tokens.usage: Text on `tertiaryFixed`.

tokens.name: onTertiaryFixedVariant
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `tertiaryFixed`.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Error borders and messages, notification badge; StatusBanner icon, text and its 16% tint.

tokens.name: onError
tokens.usage: Text on `error`.

tokens.name: errorContainer
tokens.usage: Cancelled state tags. Not for StatusBanner, which uses a 16% tint of `error`.

tokens.name: onErrorContainer
tokens.usage: Text on `errorContainer`.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background (Scaffold). Light is pure white; dark is the anchored navy.

tokens.name: onSurface
tokens.usage: Primary text on `surface`, `cardSurface`, `searchSurface`; active navigation icon and label (dark); active page dot (dark). 17.10:1 light, 15.00:1 dark.

tokens.name: surfaceDim
tokens.usage: Lowest step of the surface ladder.

tokens.name: surfaceBright
tokens.usage: Highest-brightness step of the surface ladder.

tokens.name: surfaceContainerLowest
tokens.usage: Card and search bar in light (via `cardSurface`, `searchSurface`).

tokens.name: surfaceContainerLow
tokens.usage: Low cards, list sections.

tokens.name: surfaceContainer
tokens.usage: Divider in dark (via `divider`). NavigationBar uses `surface`, not this.

tokens.name: surfaceContainerHigh
tokens.usage: Card in dark (via `cardSurface`); divider in light; dark top glow.

tokens.name: surfaceContainerHighest
tokens.usage: Progress track and countdown ring track. Search bar in dark (via searchSurface). Not for text fields: in light it is a neutral grey.

tokens.name: onSurfaceVariant
tokens.usage: Secondary text, secondary icons, inactive navigation labels. On `surface`: 9.40:1 light, 11.36:1 dark.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: Text field border, inactive page dots (dark). 3:1+ on surface and cardSurface.

tokens.name: outlineVariant
tokens.usage: Card and MatchTile border in dark, inactive page dots (light). Not for divider lines: use `divider`.

tokens.name: shadow
tokens.usage: Shadows. Light cards and search bar use it at 8% opacity (`shadow-raised`).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Modal overlay.

tokens.name: inverseSurface
tokens.usage: SnackBar, tooltip.

tokens.name: onInverseSurface
tokens.usage: Text on `inverseSurface`.

tokens.name: inversePrimary
tokens.usage: Action label inside SnackBar, on `inverseSurface`.

tokens.name: surfaceTint
tokens.usage: Elevation tint. Mirrors `primary`.

tokens.name: success-color
tokens.usage: Status icons and text in success state; filled status buttons; StatusBanner icon, text and its 16% tint.

tokens.name: success-onColor
tokens.usage: Text on `success-color`.

tokens.name: success-container
tokens.usage: Progress bar value; success tags. Same in both themes. Not for StatusBanner, which uses a 16% tint of `success-color`.

tokens.name: success-onContainer
tokens.usage: Text on `success-container`.

tokens.name: warning-color
tokens.usage: Status icons and text in warning state; filled status buttons.

tokens.name: warning-onColor
tokens.usage: Text on `warning-color`.

tokens.name: warning-container
tokens.usage: Warning tags and banners. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: warning-onContainer
tokens.usage: Text on `warning-container`.

tokens.name: info-color
tokens.usage: Status icons and text in info state; filled status buttons.

tokens.name: info-onColor
tokens.usage: Text on `info-color`.

tokens.name: info-container
tokens.usage: Deck icon in dark (on `tileSurface`); info tags and banners. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: info-onContainer
tokens.usage: Text on `info-container`.

tokens.name: cardSurface
tokens.usage: Card background. Cards are raised by tone, not shadow (M3 tonal elevation): light is primary at 8% over surface (#ffffff), dark is surfaceContainerHigh. No shadow and no border in either theme.

tokens.name: searchSurface
tokens.usage: SearchBar background, same tone as cardSurface. No shadow.

tokens.name: tileSurface
tokens.usage: Background of the 64 × 64 deck icon tile (`size-tile`). Light also feeds the right stop of the top glow. Source: info palette tone 97 in light, secondary palette tone 24 in dark.

tokens.name: divider
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers, top border of NavigationBar. Source: surfaceContainerHigh in light, surfaceContainer in dark.

tokens.name: seed-background-light
tokens.usage: Primitive, for regenerating the scheme only. Never reference it from widgets. Anchors the light surface ladder.

tokens.name: seed-background-dark
tokens.usage: Primitive, for regenerating the scheme only. Never reference it from widgets. Anchors the dark surface ladder.

tokens.name: seed-primary
tokens.usage: Primitive, for regenerating the scheme only. Never reference it from widgets. Primary seed, kept exact in both themes.

tokens.name: seed-secondary
tokens.usage: Primitive, for regenerating the scheme only. Never reference it from widgets. Secondary seed; also drives secondary text and outlines.

tokens.name: seed-success
tokens.usage: Primitive, for regenerating the scheme only. Never reference it from widgets. Seed of the success family.

tokens.name: seed-warning
tokens.usage: Primitive, for regenerating the scheme only. Never reference it from widgets. Seed of the warning family.

tokens.name: seed-info
tokens.usage: Primitive, for regenerating the scheme only. Never reference it from widgets. Seed of the info family.

families.sans: "Be Vietnam Pro", "Noto Sans KR", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: display-term
styles.usage: The word being studied on a flashcard (Flutter displaySmall). onSurface on cardSurface, centered, one line. Regular weight, as on the reference screen.

styles.name: term-tile
styles.usage: Korean word inside a MatchTile (Flutter headlineSmall). onSurface on cardSurface, centered, max 2 lines.

styles.name: display-stat
styles.usage: Key numbers that replace a sentence: due count, stat values (Flutter displayMedium). Numbers only, never words.

styles.name: title-section
styles.usage: Section headings on a screen (Flutter titleLarge). onSurface on surface.

styles.name: title-card
styles.usage: Card titles and key numbers in compact stats (Flutter titleMedium). onSurface on cardSurface. Max 2 lines.

styles.name: title-item
styles.usage: Item and row titles: deck name, ActionRow label, card header row (Flutter titleSmall). onSurface. Max 2 lines.

styles.name: body-content
styles.usage: Card content the learner reads: meaning on Review, Recall and Fill cards (Flutter bodyLarge). onSurface on cardSurface. Kept at 16 for reading; interface copy uses body.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Interface copy: list subtitles, hints next to an icon (Flutter bodyMedium). onSurfaceVariant for subtitles.

styles.name: body-tile
styles.sample: Between / Ở giữa (Danh từ, chỉ khoảng cách hoặc vị trí giữa hai vật hoặc người)
styles.usage: Meaning text inside a MatchTile, on MatchScreen and as answer options on GuessScreen (Flutter bodySmall). onSurface on cardSurface, centered, max 7 lines.

styles.name: label-button
styles.usage: Button labels in both Button sizes (Flutter labelLarge). onPrimary on primary. Regular weight: button text is not bold.

styles.name: label-meta
styles.usage: Progress text, search placeholder, banner message, counts (Flutter labelMedium). onSurfaceVariant.

styles.name: label-nav
styles.usage: NavigationBar labels (Flutter labelSmall). primary when selected in light, onSurface when selected in dark, onSurfaceVariant otherwise.

spacing.note: Values in dp (1px here = 1 logical pixel in Flutter). 4-step scale.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Icon to its label inside a control.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Small gaps between related controls; chip internals.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Progress track to its label inside the continue card.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Deck tile to its text; heading to the content right under it.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Screen side margin, card inner padding, between list items, card to page indicator.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Card title block to the progress track.

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: Between page sections (page indicator to the next section heading).

tokens.name: margin-screen
tokens.usage: Left and right screen margin on compact windows (< 600dp), Material 3. Header, content, study screens and full-bleed rails all use it.

tokens.name: margin-screen-medium
tokens.usage: Screen margin from 600dp (medium, expanded). tokens.css switches --margin-screen to this value at the medium breakpoint.

radius.note: Material 3 shape scale: extra-small 4, small 8, medium 12, large 16, extra-large 28, full.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Extra-small (M3). Small marks such as the progress stop dot or tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small (M3). Deck icon tile, NoticeBanner, chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Medium (M3). Cards: content cards, study cards, MatchTile, DeckCard, mode tiles, text field.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Large (M3). Navigation drawer and large sheets' edges. Not used for cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Extra-large (M3). Dialogs and bottom sheets.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Buttons, search bar, progress track and value, page dots, avatar, badge, navigation indicator.

shadow.note: No resting shadows: surfaces are separated by tone (M3 tonal elevation).

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Kept for compatibility and set to none: cards and the search bar are raised by tone (cardSurface, searchSurface). Do not add shadows to cards.

size.note: Fixed component and icon sizes in dp.

tokens.name: size-control
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target and icon button size (48). Not the visual height of Button or SearchBar.

tokens.name: size-button
tokens.usage: Default Button height (M3 Expressive S). Standalone actions: study action bar, full-width button in a card.

tokens.name: size-button-small
tokens.usage: Small Button height (M3 Expressive XS). A button sharing a row with other content, e.g. Continue next to the ProgressRing. Touch target stays 48.

tokens.name: size-search
tokens.usage: SearchBar height (M3).

tokens.name: size-avatar
tokens.usage: Profile avatar.

tokens.name: size-tile
tokens.usage: Deck icon tile in lists.

tokens.name: size-nav
tokens.usage: NavigationBar height (M3 Expressive flexible navigation bar), excluding the system gesture inset.

tokens.name: size-rail
tokens.usage: NavigationRail width on medium and expanded windows (600dp and up).

tokens.name: size-nav-indicator-width
tokens.usage: Width of the pill behind the selected destination icon in NavigationBar and NavigationRail.

tokens.name: size-nav-indicator-height
tokens.usage: Height of that pill.

tokens.name: size-icon
tokens.usage: Navigation, search and overflow icons.

tokens.name: size-icon-tile
tokens.usage: Deck icon inside size-tile.

tokens.name: size-track
tokens.usage: Linear progress track height (M3).

tokens.name: size-badge
tokens.usage: Notification dot on the avatar, with a 2px surface ring.

tokens.name: size-dot
tokens.usage: Page indicator dot, 6px apart (14px pitch).

tokens.name: size-dot-small
tokens.usage: Trailing page indicator dot.

tokens.name: size-content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the single content column on compact windows and of study sessions on every window. Below 600dp the column fills the width.

tokens.name: size-content-max-wide
tokens.usage: Max width of the two-column content area on medium and expanded windows (600dp and up), centered.

tokens.name: breakpoint-medium
tokens.usage: Window width where the layout switches from compact (one column, NavigationBar) to medium (NavigationRail). Material 3 window size class.

tokens.name: breakpoint-expanded
tokens.usage: Window width where medium becomes expanded. Same navigation as medium; more room for two-column content.

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: divider lines and the dark card border (outlineVariant). Measured as 2 physical px.

tokens.name: stroke-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring in primary, offset 2px.

opacity.note: Material 3 state layers, drawn in the content color of the component.

tokens.name: opacity-hover
tokens.usage: Hover overlay.

tokens.name: opacity-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed overlay.

tokens.name: opacity-focus
tokens.usage: Focus overlay (keyboard focus), drawn together with the focus ring.

tokens.name: opacity-dragged
tokens.usage: Dragged overlay.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled-content
tokens.usage: Disabled text and icons (onSurface).

tokens.name: opacity-disabled-container
tokens.usage: Disabled container fill (onSurface).

motion.note: Material 3 motion: easing curves and durations. Enter with decelerate, exit with accelerate, move on screen with standard or emphasized.

tokens.name: motion-easing-standard
tokens.usage: Small, utility moves that start and end on screen (color, opacity changes).

tokens.name: motion-easing-standard-decelerate
tokens.usage: Small elements entering the screen.

tokens.name: motion-easing-standard-accelerate
tokens.usage: Small elements leaving the screen, e.g. a matched MatchTile fading out.

tokens.name: motion-easing-emphasized
tokens.usage: Expressive moves that start and end on screen: card swipe in ReviewScreen, page transitions. Flutter Easing.emphasizedDecelerate/Accelerate pair or Curves.easeInOutCubicEmphasized.

tokens.name: motion-easing-emphasized-decelerate
tokens.usage: Expressive enter: next card or screen arriving.

tokens.name: motion-easing-emphasized-accelerate
tokens.usage: Expressive exit: card or screen leaving.

tokens.name: motion-easing-linear
tokens.usage: Only for progress over time, such as the 15 s countdown ring.

tokens.name: motion-duration-short2
tokens.usage: Selection and state-layer changes (tile selected, hover, pressed).

tokens.name: motion-duration-short3
tokens.usage: State color changes on tiles (MatchTile selected, correct, incorrect).

tokens.name: motion-duration-short4
tokens.usage: Small exits and fades: matched MatchTile fade-out, banner dismiss.

tokens.name: motion-duration-medium2
tokens.usage: Small enters and component expand: banner appear, indicator pill move.

tokens.name: motion-duration-medium4
tokens.usage: Card swipe and page transitions; also the hold time after a correct answer.

tokens.name: motion-duration-long4
tokens.usage: Large transitions; also the hold time after a wrong match before tiles reset.
